# Hybrid intelligence on the Web: Introducing Aion Instruct and Prompt API in Microsoft Edge

- Thread starter TWF Bot
- Start date

#### TWF Bot

Staff member

- Joined
- Nov 29, 2020

- Messages
- 3,691

- Thread Author
- #1

Rapidly evolving AI capabilities are redefining what sites can do for users on the web. With on-device AI in Microsoft Edge, sites can use task-specific and small language models for capabilities such as writing assistance, summarization, language detection, translation, and speech recognition. Through the Prompt API, they can also use a small language model for more general-purpose intelligence. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for hybrid intelligence on the web: developers can leverage on-device AI models when they are available in the browser and well-suited, and switch to a configured cloud provider to extend device coverage or access more powerful inference when needed. To make on-device inference more broadly available, we're introducing three updates today:

- General availability of Aion Instruct as an open-weights model on Hugging Face, and as Microsoft Edge's built-in small language model.
- An origin trial for the Prompt API, so you can use the Prompt API and Aion Instruct on your live site today.
- A developer preview of an experimental Decisions API, which gets you fast, structured answers about text.

## Aion Instruct is now generally available in Edge
Aion Instruct is available today as an open-weights model on Hugging Face and is coming to Windows later this year, laying the foundation for richer on-device AI experiences across Windows and Copilot+ PCs. In Microsoft Edge, Aion now replaces Phi-4-mini as the browser's built-in small language model. At 2.3B parameters, Aion is smaller, faster, and available on many more devices than Phi, while delivering comparable quality for common web tasks such as text synthesis and generation, summarization, instruction following, and structured outputs. Edge downloads Aion Instruct only when a site or feature first needs it, and only on devices that can run it well. Users stay in control and can turn off on-device AI in Edge settings, which removes the model and stops future downloads.

## Test the Prompt API on your live site
Until now, the Prompt API has been available as a developer preview only in Edge Canary and Dev channels. Now, with the Prompt API origin trial, you can call the API from your live site in Microsoft Edge and test it with a much broader audience. The origin trial lets you bring on-device AI features to your site, evaluate them under real-world conditions, and refine your implementation based on actual usage. Along the way, please share feedback on the API's design, the model's performance, and any interoperability challenges you encounter across different browsers and models. This will help inform discussions with other browser vendors and the web community as the Prompt API is considered for standardization. To get started, register for the Prompt API Origin Trial, read the developer documentation, try out the playground sample, and engage with us on the GitHub discussion about the API.

## Developer preview of the Decisions API
We're also exploring new uses for on-device AI with an early implementation of the experimental Decisions API, powered by Aion Instruct. It is available as a developer preview in Edge Canary and Dev channels for prototyping. Expect both the API and its implementation to change as we learn from developer feedback. The Decisions API enables sites to ask yes/no, multiple-choice, or scoring questions about text input and get back probabilities and a confidence value, computed in a single pass without any text generation. For instance, you can use the Decisions API to understand a user's intent and act on it, sort and route user-generated content, or score and rank items in real-time, all with a few lines of client-side JavaScript code: 
// Ask three questions about a product review in a single pass

const model = await DecisionModel.create({

"context": "Customer reviews for an online electronics store",

"questions": [

{

"id": "topic",

"type": "choice",

"prompt": "What is the review mainly about?",

"options": [

{ "label": "quality", "description": "How the product works or feels" },

{ "label": "shipping", "description": "Delivery, packaging, or delays" },

{ "label": "price", "description": "Cost or value for money" }

]

},

{

"id": "rating",

"type": "score",

"prompt": "How satisfied is the customer, from 1 to 5?"

},

{

"id": "needs_reply",

"type": "boolean",

"prompt": "Is the customer asking for help?"

}

]

});

// Get a label, probabilities, and a confidence value for each question

const result = await model.decide(

"Love the headphones, but the box arrived crushed. Can I get a replacement?"

);

## Try it out and let us know
These updates are another step toward bringing hybrid intelligence to the web, giving developers more options to use on-device AI when it's well-suited and combine it with cloud inference when needed. With Aion Instruct now smaller, faster, and more broadly available, we're excited to see the new web experiences you'll build. We're actively looking for feedback on model performance and interoperability for the Prompt and Summarizer APIs. If you try the experimental Decisions API, let us know what you're building, if the API design works for you, and whether your latency requirements warrant a smaller model. We look forward to you testing the Prompt API using the Origin Trial, checking out the developer documentation and playground samples, and sharing your feedback with us on GitHub.

cross_cutting.content:
# Google Launches Gemini 4 Neon Mid-Tier AI Model: What's New?

## Google has launched Gemini 4 Neon, its latest AI model designed for coding, enterprise tasks and scientific workflows. The model offers four thinking levels and a one-million-token context window. Google claims Neon completes tasks three times faster than Carbon at roughly 60% of the cost.

FPJ Web DeskUpdated: Friday, November 20, 2026, 11:03 AM IST

Google released Gemini 4 Neon, the latest model in its Gemini 4 family. The company says it brings frontier-level intelligence with fast task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work and science workflows.

Gemini 4 Neon: Where it fits

Google describes Carbon as the model for its hardest, long-horizon projects and Hydrogen as the one for fast everyday execution. Neon is meant to balance depth and efficiency between the two. It is the fourth Gemini 4 model in roughly seven weeks. It replaces Argon, which was introduced only on October 1, and Gemini 3.1 Pro.

Gemini 4 Neon: What's new

- Thinking levels: Neon offers four levels of thinking (low, medium, high and extra-high) and a context window of one million tokens. Google says teams can use the levels to balance intelligence against token spend.

- Cost and speed: Google says Neon completes tasks about three times faster than Carbon at roughly 60% of the cost. At the default high setting, it claims a 32% lower cost per task than Carbon.

- Rankings: Google says Neon ranks third overall on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 61 at its highest thinking level. It also ranks second on the Vals Index. Artificial Analysis itself describes the gain over Carbon as small, at about 17% lower cost per task.

- Coding: Neon ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index with a score of 58.6. Google says it is built for long-running, tool-heavy agent workflows and can act as an orchestrator directing parallel Hydrogen subagents in its Antigravity coding platform.

- Enterprise work: Google says the model can combine spreadsheets, PDFs, charts, audio and video in a single context window and turn them into structured deliverables.

- Cybersecurity: A version called Neon for cyber will roll out to trusted defenders in the coming days through Google's Fairwind Program. Google says it sets a new high on several vulnerability-finding and exploit-testing benchmarks.

- Safety: Google says Neon keeps Carbon-level protections against severe misuse and prompt injection. It also reports a 99.2% pass rate on its internal agent honesty evaluation.

Gemini 4 Neon: Pricing

Neon costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens through the API. Cached input is $0.15 per million tokens. That is higher than the current promotional rates for Carbon, which are $2 and $10 respectively. Google's cost-per-task claims rest on the model finishing work with fewer tokens rather than on a lower per-token price.

Gemini 4 Neon: Availability

Neon is rolling out in the Gemini API through Google AI Studio and in Gemini for business. Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can select it in the Gemini app, and paid Pro and Ultra subscribers can use it in Antigravity. In the Gemini app, Google says it handles tasks such as analysing billing statements and cross-checking receipts.

cross_cutting.content:
IT Brief UK - Technology news for CIOs & IT decision-makers

# Joveo launches Tandem AI recruiting agent for hiring
Thu, 19th Nov 2026 (Today) 
SOFIAH NICHOLE SALIVIO News Editor

Joveo has launched Tandem, an AI recruiting agent for recruiters, sourcers and hiring teams. The product is available now with a free plan.

Tandem is designed to handle several stages of hiring through a single chat interface. Users describe a role in plain language, and the system drafts a job description, identifies potential candidates, contacts them, screens applicants, conducts recorded AI interviews and books shortlisted candidates into calendars.

Joveo said the person hiring remains responsible for final decisions. It also said the system does not automatically reject candidates and tells applicants when AI is involved in the process.

How it works

According to Joveo, setup takes less than five minutes. Once configured, the tool runs sourcing, screening and interview steps with limited manual input, while recruiters can monitor candidate progress and move applicants through the process within the application.

Tandem also assigns candidates a score out of 100 and provides the evidence behind it, according to Joveo. Outreach can be sent by email, SMS or both, and candidates who pass earlier stages can choose open interview slots on a recruiter's or hiring manager's calendar.

The product includes a status page for each applicant and sends an email after each step to reduce uncertainty during the process. Joveo said first contact is always made by email and includes an unsubscribe link.

Market push

The launch reflects continued efforts by recruitment technology providers to automate administrative parts of hiring while keeping human oversight in place for decisions. Tools that generate job descriptions, search for potential candidates and manage scheduling have become more common, but Joveo is packaging those functions into a single workflow aimed at individual recruiters as well as teams.

Joveo said Tandem is built on the same technology it provides to large employers. By offering the new product without a contract requirement, the company could broaden access beyond large corporate customers to smaller teams and individual recruiters.

Joveo describes itself as a recruiting technology provider serving employers, staffing firms, recruitment process outsourcing businesses and recruitment media agencies. It said its broader platform is used across millions of jobs each day by hiring teams around the world.

The launch also comes as companies across software categories push conversational interfaces deeper into work tools. In recruitment, that trend has raised questions about bias, candidate transparency and how far employers should rely on automation in screening and interviews.

Joveo said Tandem includes safeguards intended to address some of those concerns. Candidates are informed when AI is being used, while the final hiring decision remains with a human recruiter or manager.

Kshitij Jain, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Joveo, framed the launch as an attempt to give recruiters a simpler way to run hiring processes through natural language prompts.

"Software developers today build complex applications in minutes, not months. AI tools like Claude Code transformed software development, turning natural language into production-ready code. What if recruiting teams had the same power?" said Kshitij Jain, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Joveo.

"What if recruiters could describe their hiring goals in plain English and watch AI orchestrate the entire recruiting workflow, from sourcing to interviewing? Tandem makes this possible. Welcome to the era of vibe recruiting!" Jain said.

cross_cutting.content:
# NuPlay eyes $100 million revenue with AI push

## Acquisitions, new platforms to drive expansion beyond voice AI

Mukesh Bansal, co-founder of Myntra and Curefit, is positioning NuPlay AI as a full-fledged enterprise AI platform that builds and deploys autonomous AI agents for large businesses, moving beyond its origins as a conversational voice AI startup. The two-year-old company, which currently generates around $10 million in revenue, aims to double this figure over the next six to nine months and reach $100 million in three years.

Formerly known as Nurix, the company expanded its offerings in August, moving beyond voice-based customer interactions to build customised AI agents that can perform a wider range of enterprise functions. Its platform comprises two components: NuPlay, which deploys voice and chat agents for customer engagement, sales and support, and NuStack, an engine that enables enterprises to build customised AI agents for their specific requirements. Besides the technology, the company also provides deployment support through Forward Deployed Engineers, who work closely with clients to integrate AI into their operations. The team is already present in India and the US and will expand as business grows, Bansal told FE.

NuPlay is focusing on retail and financial services, targeting the top 200 companies rather than smaller businesses. Its retail customers are largely based in the US, while the company is also looking to expand its presence in India. However, the pace of enterprise AI adoption differs considerably between the two markets, largely because of labour costs. “The US is easily a year ahead of India and they’re motivated to automate more because of high costs. Indian enterprises are also aggressive but still very judicious at AI spend,” Bansal said. While a large US company could have 20 AI initiatives underway, a similarly sized Indian enterprise may have only three or four, he added. Price sensitivity among Indian customers also puts pressure on margins, although the emergence of advanced open-weight AI models has helped bring down costs.

Advertisement

To accelerate customer acquisition and geographical expansion, NuPlay is also looking at acquisitions. In July, it acquired AI-powered customer support automation firm Verloop.io, gaining access to customers in India and West Asia, besides its technology capabilities. “Over the next year, we are looking to acquire one more mid-sized revenue firm with an established customer footprint to accelerate expansion,” Bansal said.

The startup is also developing NuLoop, a self-learning layer designed to help AI agents improve their performance by analysing previous transactions, identifying shortcomings and making adjustments to subsequent interactions. Launched a quarter ago, the technology has so far been deployed in a limited capacity, with Bansal describing the initial results as promising. However, the agents are not yet in production, and their deployment within enterprises will have to be gradual and cautious.

cross_cutting.content:
ai.com 推出可代表使用者採取行動的自主 AI 代理，而不只是聊天 - CoinJournal

ai.com 讓使用者無需編寫程式碼，即可在約 60 秒內建立個人 AI 代理。

代理能跨應用程式執行任務，並在需要時建立新功能。

改進成果會在整個網路中共享，提升代理的整體效能。

將人工智慧從對話推進到實際執行的競賽正迅速升溫。

由加密貨幣業界高層 Kris Marszalek 創立的全新消費型 AI 平台 ai.com，正帶著自主 AI 代理進入市場。這些代理旨在代表使用者行動，而不只是回應提示。

該公司表示，其代理能整理工作、跨應用程式執行任務，甚至自行建立缺少的工具；這項進展可能讓 AI 更深入融入日常數位生活。

從加密貨幣規模到消費型 AI 雄心

ai.com 由 Kris Marszalek 領導，他最為人熟知的身分是全球最大消費型加密貨幣平台之一 Crypto.com 的共同創辦人兼執行長。

Marszalek 將繼續領導兩家公司，並將 ai.com 定位為面向大眾市場的 AI 產品，而非小眾開發者工具。

該平台允許使用者在約 60 秒內建立個人 AI 代理，無需編寫程式碼或進行技術設定。

不同於一般聊天機器人，這些代理旨在執行各種行動，例如傳送訊息、管理行事曆、自動化工作流程或建立簡單的專案。

ai.com 表示，如果任務需要尚不存在的功能，代理甚至能自行建立新功能。

這些改進經過驗證後，便會在更廣泛的代理網路中共享。理論上，這會形成飛輪效應：使用的代理越多，所有代理的能力就越強。

Marszalek 將此描述為一種去中心化系統，可能加速邁向通用人工智慧（AGI）的進程：能以近似人類的水準執行各種任務的 AI 系統。

「AI 的演進正迎來根本性的轉變，我們正迅速超越基本的聊天功能，邁向能真正替人類完成工作的 AI 代理，」ai.com 創辦人兼執行長 Kris Marszalek 表示。

我們的願景是打造一個由數十億個代理組成的去中心化網路，讓它們自主改進並彼此分享這些改進成果，大幅且迅速地擴展代理能力，並加速 AGI 時代的到來。

ai.com 將於 2026 年 2 月 8 日正式推出代理產品，並在 NBC 播出的第 LX 屆超級盃期間進行備受矚目的廣告首播。

自主性與隱私及監管的交會

儘管前景令人振奮，自主代理仍立即引發安全、隱私和問責方面的疑問。

ai.com 表示，每個代理都在安全且隔離的環境中運作，使用者資料以個別金鑰加密，且代理的行動嚴格受限於使用者授予的權限。

如果代理獲准交易股票、處理付款或與第三方平台互動，這套架構很快就會面臨考驗。

尤其是金融監管機構，很可能會仔細審查：當 AI 代理出錯或執行有害行動時，責任應如何歸屬。

該公司表示，使用者將保有完全控制權，所有行動皆以權限為依據。不過，真正的挑戰在於證明消費級自主功能能夠大規模推展，而不會帶來新的風險。

ai.com 提供免費入門方案，並設有提供更進階功能的付費訂閱級別。

目前正在探索的其他功能包括金融整合、代理市集，以及連結人類、代理和代理機構的社群網路。

目前，ai.com 的推出象徵消費型 AI 論述出現轉變：從提問轉向完成任務。

# Firebird expands AI infrastructure in Armenia with Dell Technologies

3 minute read

Firebird is expanding its computing capacity as part of its ongoing collaboration with Dell Technologies, supporting the development of Armenia’s artificial intelligence ecosystem, the company said.

Firebird has completed the first phase of construction of its AI cluster in Hrazdan. The cluster is built around a Dell PowerRack system with Dell PowerEdge servers and NVIDIA Blackwell graphics processing units. Researchers, developers and companies in Armenia and across the region can now work in a fully operational AI environment. The cluster provides the computing power needed for work in life sciences, autonomous systems, space technologies and materials science.

In the next phase, Firebird plans to increase its computing capacity for training and running AI models. The expansion will allow the company to serve corporate customers worldwide on a larger scale from Armenia and strengthen the country’s position as a hub for AI innovation.

“With this agreement, we are continuing our collaboration with Dell Technologies and expanding our ability to provide advanced computing capacity for large-scale AI workloads. We see that emerging markets can play a greater role in meeting global demand for AI. As we build this capacity, we are committed to delivering the quality of service and system reliability that international customers expect and to adhering to responsible business principles. That is how we build lasting trust and secure long-term growth,” said Razmig Hovaghimian, co-founder and CEO of Firebird.

“Firebird and Dell Technologies share the goal of making the computing power needed for AI innovation more accessible. Dell Technologies provides advanced AI systems to organisations around the world. The results of our work together have laid the groundwork for the next phase, which will allow Firebird to serve customers worldwide and help expand Armenia’s role in the AI ecosystem,” said Mohammed Amin, senior vice-president for the CEEMETA region at Dell Technologies.

The expansion is part of Firebird’s long-term plan to build a global AI infrastructure business from Armenia, using its computing capacity to serve AI companies and corporate customers around the world.

Semidynamics and Nokia have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore how their AI computing and data center networking technologies could support Europe’s sovereign AI ambitions.The companies will assess how their complementary technologies could work together in large-scale AI infrastructure and explore additional options for organizations building AI infrastructure.

The collaboration will explore opportunities to assess, test, validate and, where appropriate, integrate Semidynamics’ AI accelerators and liquid cooled racks with Nokia’s Data Center Fabric solutions. As part of this work, Semidynamics will evaluate Nokia’s networking technologies and related solutions for its AI inference racks.

Semidynamics is developing proprietary RISC-V-based AI inference technology and integrated systems, while Nokia provides the AI-optimized networking solutions that connect computing systems within data centers. Their shared objective is to strengthen Europe’s capacity to develop and deploy AI infrastructure using European technology. This work will help assess the feasibility of integrated solutions and inform potential joint technical and commercial propositions. For organizations developing sovereign AI infrastructure, the intended value is a broader base of technology expertise and potential options for future deployments.

“Europe’s AI ambitions need European technology that can be deployed at scale. Working with Nokia gives us a framework to advance our memory-centric inference platform alongside the networking needed for large AI infrastructure. Our aim is to give customers a stronger European technology offering for deploying AI at scale,” said Roger Espasa, CEO, Semidynamics.

“Strengthening Europe’s AI capabilities means contributing technology and expertise to advance a broader, open ecosystem for trusted AI infrastructure. Through this agreement, we will explore how computing and connectivity can work together to support organizations developing sovereign AI infrastructure with trusted technologies,” concluded Matthieu Bourguignon, SVP, Network Infrastructure Europe, Nokia.

# Argentum AI signs USD $630 million Kyndryl data deal
Thu, 19th Nov 2026 (Today) 
MARA SUGUE News Editor

Argentum AI has signed a USD $630 million data centre agreement with Kyndryl, covering 20 years and an initial 10 megawatts of capacity.

The site will host NVIDIA B300 systems for AI inference, with deployment already under way in a Tier III facility, the companies said.

The deal brings together a GPU cloud provider that finances and operates its own clusters and an IT infrastructure services group that runs large-scale technology environments for customers in more than 60 countries.

Argentum said the arrangement gives it access to a facility built for the power density required by current-generation GPU systems and is intended to give customers faster access to inference capacity.

Under the collaboration, Kyndryl will provide facility capacity and data centre operations. Argentum said it is deploying the systems as part of its effort to serve AI model builders, inference providers and enterprise customers that rent dedicated bare-metal GPU capacity.

Inference focus

The agreement centres on AI inference rather than model training, reflecting a growing area of the AI infrastructure market as companies seek to run production workloads at scale.

Argentum described itself as the flagship anchor tenant at the facility. It said its technology supports widely used AI applications, but did not identify specific customers in the announcement.

The companies also said they intend to expand their work together as Argentum grows. They did not disclose additional financial terms or expansion targets.

For Argentum, the arrangement secures a long-term base for GPU deployment at a time when access to suitable data centre space and power remains constrained in many markets. Facilities able to support dense GPU installations have become a key bottleneck for companies expanding AI services.

For Kyndryl, the deal adds a named AI infrastructure tenant to its data centre operations business and gives it a role in a market segment tied to demand for inference computing.

"Partnering with an established technology services and infrastructure provider like Kyndryl is an important milestone for Argentum AI," said Andrew Sobko, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Argentum AI.

"This agreement reflects our shared commitment to expanding secure, high-performance compute infrastructure and supporting the growing demands of enterprises embracing AI at scale."

Kyndryl described the arrangement as a new use for its available capacity and operational experience in mission-critical environments.

"Our agreement gives us a unique opportunity to put Kyndryl capacity to work in an innovative way. Coupled with our mission-critical capabilities and decades of operational and services experience, it will support Argentum as it creates capacity for its customers," said Jamie Rutledge, President of Kyndryl U.S.

Argentum originates, finances and operates GPU clusters, then supplies dedicated infrastructure to customers that need direct access to graphics processing units for AI workloads. Kyndryl, which was spun out of IBM, focuses on designing, building, managing and modernising large information systems for enterprise and public sector users.

The collaboration underlines how specialist GPU cloud providers are turning to long-term infrastructure agreements to secure power and floor space as demand for AI inference grows.

HUMAIN获得25亿沙特里亚尔的人工智能基础设施融资

沙通社11月9日报道，沙特国家基础设施基金（Infra）与公共投资基金（PIF）旗下人工智能公司HUMAIN签署两项融资协议，总额25亿沙特里亚尔，用于支持人工智能计算部署和关键电力基础设施建设。

这两项融资是Infra人工智能数据中心融资计划（AI Data Center Financing Program）下宣布的首笔交易。2026年1月，Infra与HUMAIN曾在达沃斯论坛上宣布一项战略融资框架，涵盖价值45亿沙特里亚尔的非约束性融资条款。

此次签署的两项融资协议中，一项涉及最高可达11亿沙特里亚尔的图形处理器（GPU）融资计划，支持GPU的采购和部署，预计可满足约25兆瓦的IT负载需求；另一项涉及最高可达14亿沙特里亚尔的融资计划，将用于支持HUMAIN在沙特阿拉伯的AI数据中心建设，包括变电站、输电基础设施和电网连接。规划中的电力基础设施旨在支持未来数据中心的发展，预计IT容量可达1吉瓦。

Operating under European governance, the

Telia, Nokia, Nscale, Verda and Skeleton have formed AI Gigafactory Northern (AIGF Northern), a European consortium established to develop trusted, distributed AI infrastructure through a federated, multi-site AI Gigafactory across the Nordic and Baltic region.

Operating under European governance, the sites will combine large-scale AI computing infrastructure with sovereign cloud and AI platform services, high-capacity connectivity and decarbonized energy.

The partners intend to submit a bid to build and operate AIGF Northern under the call for tenders for AI Gigafactory consortia published by the European High-Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU).

AIGF Northern will connect AI infrastructure across multiple sites, giving businesses, researchers and public-sector organizations throughout Europe access to trusted computing, cloud and connectivity services at scale.

By distributing capacity across borders, the federated AI Gigafactory will reduce concentration risk and strengthen the resilience of Europe’s AI ecosystem.

The consortium is being developed as the EU steps up investment in European AI capacity. Through InvestAI, the EU aims to mobilize €30 billion for AI investment, combining €20 billion in private-sector funding with €10 billion from EU and national public sources.

AIGF Northern will connect facilities in Oulu, Finland; the Tallinn region in Estonia; Valmiera, Latvia; and a location yet to be determined in Sweden.

Distributing capacity across these locations will allow the consortium to draw on multiple sources of decarbonized energy, expand computing infrastructure where capacity is available and reduce reliance on any single site or supplier.

This approach will strengthen operational resilience and support cross-border expansion as European demand for AI grows.

Telia, together with its subsidiary Telia Cygate, will contribute expertise in connectivity, data transmission, infrastructure operations and sovereign cloud solutions, supporting the development of a federated, multicountry AI ecosystem.

Anders Olsson, Executive Vice President, Head of Telia Sweden, said: “Our customers – and our continent – have a rapidly increasing need for scalable and sovereign AI services. To meet this need, Europe’s best must step up. Telia’s highly relevant skills in secure and resilient connectivity and systems integration, combined with our position as a trusted partner for businesses and societies, make us a natural fit for this ambitious consortium. We look forward to working together to create even more value for customers, while helping to secure long-term European competitiveness and resilience.”

The Nordic and Baltic region offers suitable conditions for sustainable AI infrastructure, combining reliable, decarbonized energy supply, advanced digital networks and a cool climate that reduces cooling demand.

These advantages enable data centres to deliver more computing capacity from existing grid connections while supporting lower-carbon operations.

The consortium is also supported by leading research and innovation partners.

VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland, one of Europe’s leading research organizations and a partner for companies and society, brings capabilities in quantum computing, semiconductors, physical AI and photonics.

Telia also brings its collaboration with KTH Royal Institute of Technology, strengthening the consortium’s links with European academic research and technological innovation across the region.
